subject: design/local-execution-logs
statement: Claude, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode process adapters tee child stdout and stderr into private .pyxis/logs/agents/<harness>/<run> files in the persistent owning checkout. Capture preserves each adapter's existing output consumer, serializes shared stdout/stderr destinations, warns on storage failure without failing the child protocol, and closes files after process drain or failed launch.
intent: Keep raw worker diagnostics available after disposable worktrees are removed without changing process protocols or introducing a race in Codex's combined output buffer.
rationale: Worker output previously disappeared after execution or worktree removal. Capture owns only the diagnostic files and does not serialize launch environment or authentication state. A failed diagnostic sink must not prevent an otherwise valid child process from running.
fit_criterion: Runtime tests exercise persisted stdout/stderr, linked-worktree ownership, private permissions, sink failures, and adapter process lifetimes under the race detector.

provenance.note: Records raw child output retention and its failure/lifetime behavior.
